retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic winter scene featuring a classic boat on a lake at dusk with distressed, hand-drawn typography and a simple geometric icon.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered composition consisting of a grainy sky with floating graphic elements, a blue-toned mountain range, and a dark wooden boat adorned with warm string lights floating on a calm lake.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange lights contrasting against cool blue twilight tones
Rough, distressed typography floating in the negative space of the sky
A flat, red geometric crown icon providing a bold focal point in the upper left
Horizontal layering of water, mountains, and sky
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain texture across the entire image
Low-contrast, muted color palette dominated by blues and deep reds
Small Christmas tree silhouette on the boat deck

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The boat is positioned in the lower third, small in scale to emphasize the vastness of the landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red crown icon in the upper left and the boat in the lower center create a diagonal balance.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the red crown, moves right across the large text, then drops down to the boat and follows the mountain line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper half of the image is primarily sky, serving as a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and slate grey (mountains and sky)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted brick red (crown icon and boat hull)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a crushed black point, giving a vintage, printed feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Informal lowercase sans-serif with irregular heights
letterConstructionRules: Rough, jagged edges mimicking torn paper or chalk
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 't' features an elongated, slightly curved crossbar
The 'n' has a wavy, irregular vertical stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly textured, custom-drawn script paired with a clean, bold slab-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Flat red crown icon with three points and white circular tips

preserve: The jagged texture of the main title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rough-edged display fonts like 'Chalkboard' or 'Torn Paper'
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the handmade, distressed feel of the primary text
Provides the sturdy, friendly slab-serif feel for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, low-contrast photograph of a classic dark wooden boat on a calm lake at twilight. The boat should have warm orange string lights and a small Christmas tree. In the background, place a hazy blue mountain range under a grey-blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a flat red crown icon in the upper left. Place the primary title in a distressed, hand-drawn white font to the right of the crown. Place the subtitle in a bold white slab-serif font directly beneath the primary title.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Does the red crown icon have white circles on the tips?
Is the boat small enough to show the mountain scale?
Is the typography sufficiently distressed and irregular?

adjustableVariables: Density of the string lights on the boat
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the distress
Ensure the orange lights are the only high-warmth element
Confirm the crown icon is flat and geometric
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy twilight landscape with a small, lit-up subject in the lower third and floating, distressed typography in the upper half.
